requirement_summary: Identify, select and initiate behavioral modifications, evaluate whether the resulting safety state is acceptable and decide whether to request continued execution.
applicable_actor: autonomous or semi-autonomous system of interest (ASOI)
governed_object: ASOI behavior modification and resulting safety state

evidence_expectation: Evaluation of whether freedom from unacceptable risk of harm is acceptable after selected behavioral modifications are initiated.
timing_or_frequency: During operation when behavior modification is used to preserve freedom from unacceptable risk of harm.
applicability_conditions: Implemented in accordance with the fail-safe design in operation process and the Clause 6 design constraints, prerequisites and characteristics.
exceptions_or_qualifications: A request to continue execution is optional and is issued only if the preceding decision determines it is needed.

requirement_summary: Provide means to inhibit execution of all safety-exempt functions at regular intervals.
applicable_actor: ASOI developer or system integrator
governed_object: autonomous or semi-autonomous system of interest (ASOI)
governance_expectation: Provide means to inhibit execution of all safety-exempt functions at regular intervals.
evidence_expectation: Objective evidence sufficient to substantiate fulfilment of the Annex A system requirement when conformance is claimed.
timing_or_frequency: At regular intervals of time.
verification_method: Assess fulfilment using the Annex A property-of-interest requirement: Dependability, Predictability; the concrete means of verification are selected and agreed by competent stakeholders under Clause 9.5.
applicability_conditions: Applies when the ASOI is capable of exhibiting the standard's Distinguishing Characteristics.
The source constrains fulfilment of this capability to safety-critical functions.
exceptions_or_qualifications: When the Distinguishing-Characteristics condition applies, total loss of the capability fulfilling the requirement is a failure event.
When the Distinguishing-Characteristics condition applies, partial loss of the capability fulfilling the requirement is a failure event irrespective of the extent of loss.
Fulfilment is limited to ASOI capabilities provided by safety-critical functions.

requirement_summary: Preserve the baseline dependability attributes of availability, maintainability, reliability and robustness.
applicable_actor: ASOI developer, integrator or competent stakeholder
governed_object: autonomous or semi-autonomous system of interest (ASOI)
governance_expectation: Preserve the baseline dependability attributes of availability, maintainability, reliability and robustness.
verification_method: Characterize the ASOI against the Dependability property and its required Availability, Maintainability, Reliability and Robustness attributes using means agreed by competent stakeholders.

exceptions_or_qualifications: Competent stakeholders may adopt comparable alternative definitions for Dependability or its constituent attributes only where credible evidence shows the alternative is widely recognized and understood as a substitute; other alterations are not permitted for conformance. Additional attributes may be agreed.
